attributes.title: PALTmed27 Annual Meeting
attributes.organizer: Post-Acute and Long-Term Care Medical Association
attributes.summary:
Nursing home medical directors and post-acute clinicians meet in Albuquerque on March 18 to 20, 2027. The prospectus counts medical directors among the main attendee groups, so peers here face similar facility problems.

The prospectus separates accredited sessions from industry sessions that carry no CME or CEU credit, so check each session before counting hours. Registration is open, and the meeting can be attended in Albuquerque or online through the Virtual Learning Experience at the same rates; both include conference recordings through April 30, 2027. Physician members pay $740 through January 15, 2027, $845 through March 10 and $970 after that; physician non-members pay $1,050, $1,155 and $1,275. Interdisciplinary professionals pay $485 to $585 as members and $555 to $660 as non-members, and one-day rates are $485 and $305. Registrations are non-refundable but can be switched between in-person and virtual. Credit totals are not published on the registration page.
